row.evidence: FloQast's December 2025 release notes say it 'now supports SCIM user provisioning and deprovisioning for those using Okta SSO in the US... Contact your ASM to have this functionality enabled', and every package on its pricing page is Contact Sales.
row.notes: Quote-only: all packages (Close Management, Close AI, Risk & Compliance) are Contact Sales with 'No Per-User Fees'. New row. SCIM (Dec 2025) works only with Okta SSO for US customers and is enabled by the ASM, so it would also be 'partial' by IdP; gated is recorded because the price gate comes first. SCIM creates users with a default Adv User role and no workspace access; deprovisioning deactivates. No JIT (stated). Entra, Google and OneLogin are SAML SSO only. Users API (v2 core) lists, gets and deactivates users; roles and groups are read-only.

plans.name: Risk & Compliance
plans.price_text: Contact Sales (available on its own or with any Close package)

scim.plan: Contact Sales (enabled by ASM; Okta, US only)
scim.notes: SCIM was added in December 2025 for Okta SSO customers in the US only; it is switched on by the customer's Accounting Success Manager. The Okta SCIM setup guide is hosted on Highspot (not a FloQast domain) and was not used.

operations.notes: Okta's OIN page also marks Update; FloQast's own docs mention only create and deactivate.

roles.how: SCIM-created users get Account Role 'Adv User' and no workspace access; an Admin or Sys Admin assigns role and entities in FloQast

limitations.text: Okta only, and only for US customers.
Provisioned users have no workspace access and a default Adv User role until an admin assigns entities, programs, projects and role.
Must be enabled by the customer's Accounting Success Manager.

auth.notes: x-api-key header; keys created by Managers and Admins under Admin Settings > API Keys with per-service scopes.

capabilities.notes: Groups and roles are read-only in the documented endpoints.

endpoints.purpose: List users sharing workspace access with the key owner (v1)

audit_log_api.notes: Audit trail covers API-key activity, not all user actions.

google.notes: FloQast lists Google SSO among its SAML IdPs; SCIM is Okta-only.

onelogin.notes: From FloQast's own SSO page; OneLogin catalogue not checked.

fallbacks.notes: Users export (Excel/PDF) exists; no CSV user import documented.

citations.title: FloQast Users API
citations.quote: [GET /users](https://developer.floqast.app/api-reference/users/users/listusers.md): Returns a paginated list of users in the authenticated tenant.

citations.title: FloQast Users API

citations.title: FloQast Roles API

citations.title: FloQast External API (v1)
citations.quote: [GET /api/v1/users](https://developer.floqast.app/api-reference/v1/openapi/users/getusers.md): This endpoint returns users who have current or historical shared workspace access with the user who the API key belongs to.

citations.title: FloQast External API (v1)

citations.title: FloQast External API (v1)
